title: Preserve both sides of a database reconciliation
goal: Compare planned and observed records with translated FullJoin while retaining matched, left-only and right-only rows.

selectionNotes: Compare planned and observed records with translated FullJoin while retaining matched, left-only and right-only rows.
Only the executed SQL Server query shape is verified; no blanket provider or SQLite promise.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: EF Core 11 requires net11.0; no EF11-on-net10.0 route is offered.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared target. Exact recorded SDKs are verification baselines; current-release proof uses GA.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared sample language mode; no C#15-specific syntax is required.

frameworks: Standalone Microsoft.NET.Sdk console; no web framework requirement

packages.name: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer
packages.reason: EF11 SQL translation/defaults; actual baseline 11.0.0. Pin SqlClient7.1.0 and Pkcs10.0.13 as in the complete standalone project.

packageAssets: EF Core/Relational/SQL Server11 lib/net11.0; Microsoft.Data.SqlClient7.1.0 ref/net9.0 with runtimes/win/lib/net9.0 selected for net11.0. Previous EF10 lib/net10.0, SqlClient6.1.7 ref/net9.0 with runtimes/win/lib/net9.0. Resolved transitive closure is recorded in each lock and verification manifest.
providers: EF Core SQL Server11 with SQL Server2025 17.0.5035.5 Developer on Linux. FullJoin needs a relational provider and server supporting FULL OUTER JOIN.
platforms: Windows x64 consumer against local Docker Linux SQL Server. Other platforms not executed.
renderingModes: Not applicable: console/database consumer; no renderer or browser
constraints: Compare planned and observed records with translated FullJoin while retaining matched, left-only and right-only rows.
Relational translation depends on query shape and provider. No SQLite support is assumed.
EF11 requires .NET11. The .NET10 comparison is not a supported target10 edition or an additional foundation.
Stable API contract checked with GA artifacts; GA reconciliation, other providers and other client platforms remain unverified.
prerequisites: Copy the complete standalone sample into its own directory, install the pinned SDK/runtime and restore the locked packages.
Supply PLAYBOOK_SQL_CONNECTION_STRING privately for an empty exclusively owned disposable playbook_ database. The sample creates tables and seeds records; remove the database afterwards.
Repository authors use eng/Test-MarshSurvey.ps1 -Record through the approved local SQL route. No cloud resource or account is needed.
stabilityLimitations: Stable API contract prepared using .NET11 GA SDK/runtime and EF11 GA packages; no experimental opt-in. Actual GA checks are limited to the recorded scope.

evidence.scope: Real SQL Server execution: deterministic tied winner IDs12/21 and related names, plus matched B/B, left-only A/null and right-only null/C. Previous EF10 uses anti-existence winner selection and left join plus right-only concatenation; EF11 uses GroupBy/First followed by navigation and translated FullJoin. Exact SDK/package closure retained in sample evidence; GA checks establish only the recorded scope.
